title: A WooCommerce order placed on live under a number the copy uses moves with its post
steps: Run the real MariaDB flow cases for a clashing HPOS order and a squatter named by a plugin row.
expect: The copy's post keeps its number; the live order, its placeholder and its rows share a new one.
A second sync keeps them there.
A plugin row naming a record moved off a remembered number is held.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=under a number the copy holds moves with its placeholder|squatting on a remembered number
tests: WooCommerce HPOS order placed on live under a number the copy holds moves with its placeholder; it never attaches to the copy post (#107)
a live record squatting on a remembered number moves, and a plugin row naming it is held, not pointed at another record (#107)
